verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents broad programmatic coverage of Outlook mail. This includes drafting, sending, replying, forwarding and deleting messages, attachments, Inbox rules, categories, flags and importance, automatic replies and working hours, folder sync, delegation, MAPI properties and change notifications. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and coverage beyond mail (calendar, contacts, client settings) is barely evidenced. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or a mapping of UI features to endpoints, documented coverage beyond mail, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI-only gaps don't exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Draft, read, reply, forward, send, update, or delete messages
Get or update a user's automatic reply, locale, time zone, or working hours
Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
app users can change the importance of a message (or event or task), or flag a message for follow-up
Access custom data for under-exposed Outlook MAPI properties
